decisions.reason: Although it is technically close to the firm's hearing-care know-how, its much weaker market presence than the similar earmold offer suggests limited differentiation or traction, so management would likely reallocate resources to stronger adjacent products and further development.

This product builds directly on the firm's existing hearing-system capabilities and customer relationships, and its dedicated presentation indicates enough early commercial promise for the firm to keep learning from and refining it.

The vacuum thermoforming unit fits the firm's established materials-and-equipment base, and with strong in-house R&D and process know-how the firm is well placed to improve and commercialise it further in a growing market.
